items.label: la défaillance
items.scene: After a long DAY, a weary runner YAWNS ("day-fah-YAHNS") and has a FAINTING spell onto the sofa, the doctor fanning her.

items.label: la schizophrénie
items.scene: A calm brass wall plaque spells out SCHIZOPHRÉNIE, a serious illness of the mind that doctors can treat, said skee-zoh-fray-NEE.

items.label: la filiation
items.scene: A duck family tree on an easel, grand-duck to mum to duckling, joined by lines of FILIATION ("fee-lyah-SYOHN").

items.label: la vaccination
items.scene: A grandpa proudly shows his grandson the star sticker from his VACCINATION ("vahk-see-nah-SYOHN").

items.label: le diagnostic
items.scene: The DIAGNOSIS for an elephant: the doctor points at an X-ray of its long NOSE ("-nohs-") on the TEAK ("TEEK") desk.

items.label: le pronostic
items.scene: The doctor smiles at a parrot with a bandaged wing: good PROGNOSIS ("proh-nos-TEEK"), flying in a week.

items.label: le refroidissement
items.scene: As REF of a soup-COOLING contest, Roy (recurring character: a jolly round-faced grandpa with a short white beard, a little gold paper crown, a green cardigan) ("ruhf-RWAH") tastes the steaming soup as an ice cube plops in, a snowMAN ("MAHN") beside him.

items.label: sanitaire
items.scene: A SANITARY ("sah-nee-TEHR") inspection: the doctor's cat creeps along the bookshelf checking for dust.
